about: GTA 6 'It has X, shown' (Delta, slug gta-fridge): in Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (Aug 27 2026, 'captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5'), a man walks up to a fridge in a pink apartment, a FRIDGE button prompt appears, the fridge opens on a selection list (LOGGER BEER, LAVAZAS BEER, BLITZ BERRY SMOOTHIE, BLITZ GREEN SMOOTHIE, PROTEIN SHAKE; the smoothie and shake rows carry two small icons the beer rows don't), a FLEECA BANK magnet sits on the door, and with a bottle in hand the prompts read DRINK / DROP (7:15-7:23, 435-443.5 s). Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six has a fridge menu.

lines.text: Walk up, and the prompt just says: fridge.
Open it, and you pick from a list.
Logger and Lavazas beer, berry and green Blitz smoothies, and a protein shake.
lines.say: Logger and Lah-vah-zas beer, berry and green Blitz smoothies, and a protein shake.

lines.text: The beers get no icons. The smoothies and the shake get two. Rockstar hasn't said what they do.
Fleeca Bank is even on the fridge door.
lines.say: Flee-ka Bank is even on the fridge door.

lines.text: Drink, or drop. That's the prompt once you grab one.
